blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative model pre-training typically optimizes a model as a whole without explicitly organizing its parameters for selective reuse. Decomposable pre-training instead learns reusable components for downstream adaptation while retaining strong generative performance. However, existing knowledge diversion methods incur substantial parameter overhead through weight factorization and rely on fixed component assignments to induce specialization, potentially compromising in-distribution generation quality. We therefore propose Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv), which learns how generative knowledge is shared and specialized for effective generation and selective downstream reuse. SGKDiv constructs Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels, preserving native computational structure without SVD-based reparameterization. Calibrated condition-wise routing combines a shared usage prior with conditional adjustments, while complementary regularization shapes their allocation, diversity, and magnitude. Together, these designs replace predefined component assignments with adaptively learned and explicitly regulated knowledge specialization. Experiments across diverse model and training settings demonstrate better in-distribution generation than dense and MoE baselines, alongside stronger downstream adaptation than representative PEFT methods across eight datasets.
blocks.zh: 基因模型预训一般会在没有明确组织其参数进行选择性再利用的情况下,将模型整体优化. 可分解的预培训则学习下游适应的可再利用组件,同时保留强的遗传性能. 然而,现有知识转移方法通过权重因素化产生大量参数间接费用,并依赖固定组成部分的任务来诱发专业化,这有可能损害分配生成的质量。 因此,我们提议采用特定性指导知识转移(SGKDiv),以学习如何分享基因知识,并专门用于有效生成和选择性下游再利用。 SGKDiv 构造 知识单位从对接的饲料向前通道,在不以SVD为基础的再参数化的情况下,保留本土计算结构. 校准条件的路由在条件调整之前结合了共享的用法,而互补的规范化则塑造了它们的分配,多样性和规模. 这些设计共同取代了预先确定的组件任务,以适应性地学习并明确规范知识专业化. 不同模式和培训环境的实验表明,分布式生成比密集度基线和教育部基线要好,而下游的适应性比8个数据集中有代表性的PEFT方法强。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large-scale pre-training has become a prevailing paradigm for image generation, supporting both in-distribution generation and downstream adaptation [ 4 , 66 , 64 , 39 , 18 ] .
However, optimizing a model as a whole does not explicitly distinguish transferable knowledge from source-specific information, limiting selective knowledge reuse [ 70 , 34 ] .
This motivates decomposable model pre-training [ 14 , 60 ] , which organizes knowledge into modular components to retain shared capabilities while enabling selective adaptation to downstream requirements, including varying computational constraints [ 16 , 58 ] and target-domain shifts [ 46 , 55 ] .
blocks.zh:
大规模预训已经成为图像生成的流行范例,支持分布式生成和下游适应[4,66,64,39,18].
然而,优化整个模型并没有明确区分可转让知识与特定来源信息,限制了选择性知识的再利用[70,34].
这激发了可分解的模型预训[14,60],将知识组织为模块化组件,以保留共享能力,同时能够有选择地适应下游要求,包括不同的计算制约[16,58]和目标领域转移[46,55].

blocks.zh:
图1:(a) 传统知识的转用构建了基于SVD的单位,这些单位有预先界定的共享具体任务,在退化的分流产生(FID)和大量参数管理成本下改进下游适应(FDD)。

blocks.en:
These downstream requirements motivate complementary forms of decomposability. Constraint-based pre-training [ 14 , 15 , 63 , 59 ] addresses computational constraints through size-wise knowledge reuse, encoding structured weight templates for initialization across model depths and widths.
In parallel, Knowledge Diversion (KDiv) [ 61 , 60 ] enables condition-wise reuse by organizing generative knowledge into condition-agnostic and condition-specific components, preserving shared capabilities while adapting specialized components to target conditions and domains.
blocks.zh:
这些下游要求刺激了互补的分解形式。 基于约束的预训[14,15,63,59]通过大小知识再利用,编码结构化的重量模板,用于跨模型深度和宽度的初始化,解决计算限制.
同时,知识转换(KDiv)[61,60]通过将基因知识组织成条件不可知和条件特定的组件,同时保留共享能力,同时使专门组件适应目标条件和领域,从而能够根据条件进行再利用。

blocks.en:
Despite supporting selective downstream reuse, existing knowledge diversion methods face two limitations (Fig. 1 a).
First, matrix-wise SVD introduces redundant factor parameters and treats consecutive projections independently, overlooking their computational correspondence [ 60 , 62 , 11 ] .
Meanwhile, assigning knowledge units to fixed shared and condition-specific subsets before training restricts knowledge allocation and relies on structural separation alone to induce specialization [ 61 , 49 , 65 ] .
Without explicit guidance on how condition-specific knowledge should be learned and utilized, this rigid organization can hinder generative learning and compromise in-distribution generation quality.
blocks.zh:
尽管支持选择性下游再利用,但现有的知识转移方法面临两个局限性(图1a)。
首先,矩阵式SVD引入了冗余系数参数,并独立处理连续的预测,俯瞰它们的计算对应[60,62,11].
同时,在培训前将知识单位分配给固定的共享和特定条件的子集,限制了知识的分配,仅依靠结构上的分离就可以诱导专业化[61、49、65]。
如果不就如何学习和利用特定条件的知识提供明确指导,这种僵化的组织就可能阻碍遗传学的学习并损害分配生成的质量。

blocks.en:
These limitations motivate Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv) (Fig. 1 b), which exploits native computational structure and explicitly regulates specialization.
Through adaptive routing and regularization, SGKDiv allows shared usage and condition-specific specialization of Knowledge Units to emerge during training, without a predefined partition.
This makes knowledge diversion a flexible pre-training approach with learnable, explicitly regulated knowledge allocation that supports downstream reuse while maintaining strong in-distribution generative performance.
blocks.zh:
这些限制刺激了特定指导知识转移(SGKDiv)(图1b),它利用了本土的计算结构并明确规范了专业化.
通过适应性的路由和规范化,SGKDiv允许知识单位在培训期间出现共享使用和特定条件的专业化,而无需预先设定分区.
这使得知识的转移成为一种灵活的培训前方法,具有可学习的、明确管理的知识分配,支持下游的再利用,同时保持强大的分配基因性能。

blocks.en:
Specifically, SGKDiv constructs Knowledge Units by pairing each FFN input-projection column with its corresponding output-projection row, preserving native nonlinear computation without SVD-based reparameterization.
Unlike token-wise mixture-of-experts (MoE) [ 56 , 51 , 10 ] , SGKDiv modulates Knowledge Units at the condition level.
To this end, a calibrated condition-agnostic gate defines a shared usage prior, while a condition-specific gate adjusts it in logit space to determine each unit’s contribution.
To encourage effective specialization, we introduce gate polarization to sharpen the shared usage prior, together with deviation diversity and magnitude regularization to shape distinct conditional adjustments of appropriate strength.
Such decomposable structure supports target-aware selection of Knowledge Units for parameter-efficient downstream fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,SGK Div 构造 知识单位通过将每个FFN输入-投影列与其对应的输出-投影列配对,在不进行基于SVD的再参数化的情况下保留本土非线性计算.
与象征性的混合专家(MOE)[56,51,10]不同,SGKDiv在条件层面调制知识单位.
为此,一个校准的状态不可知门定义了之前共享的用途,而一个条件特定的门则在登录空间中调整,以确定每个单位的贡献.
为了鼓励有效的专业化,我们引入了大门两极化,以强化之前的共同使用,以及偏差的多样性和规模的正规化,以形成对适当力量的明显有条件调整。
这种可分解的结构支持目标意识选择知识单位进行参数高效的下游微调.

blocks.en:
We evaluate SGKDiv on class-conditional image generation across diverse model and training configurations, including DiT (-Flow), REPA, and JiT.
SGKDiv achieves higher in-distribution generation quality than dense and MoE baselines with fewer activated parameters, demonstrating that decomposability can enhance rather than compromise generative learning.
For downstream adaptation, fine-tuning target-relevant Knowledge Units outperforms representative PEFT methods under comparable trainable parameter budgets, supporting the effectiveness of selective component reuse.
Together, these results demonstrate that SGKDiv supports effective generative pre-training and parameter-efficient downstream adaptation within a unified framework.
blocks.zh:
我们评价SGKDiv在各种模式和培训配置,包括DiT(-Flow)、REPA和JiT的有条件图像生成。
SGKDiv实现了比密度和MOE基线更高的分配生成质量,激活参数较少,表明分解性可以增强而不是损害基因学习.
对于下游的适应,微调目标相关知识单位在可比的可培训参数预算下比具有代表性的PEFT方法表现优异,支持选择性组件再利用的有效性.
这些结果共同表明,SGKDiv支持在一个统一的框架内进行有效的基因前培训和参数高效的下游适应。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are as follows:
1) We propose Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion , a generative pre-training framework that moves beyond predefined parameter allocation to learn reusable knowledge organization for both in-distribution generation and downstream adaptation.
2) We introduce native paired-channel Knowledge Units that preserve FFN pathways without SVD-based reparameterization, together with calibrated routing that explicitly regulates shared allocation and conditional specialization.
3) Experiments demonstrate improved generation quality over dense and MoE baselines, alongside stronger downstream adaptation than PEFT methods under comparable trainable parameter budgets.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献如下:
1) 我们提出具体指导知识的转移,这是一个遗传性的培训前框架,超越预先确定的参数分配,学习可重复使用的知识组织,既用于分配生成,又用于下游适应。
2)我们引入本土对流通道知识单位,在不采用基于SVD的再参数化的情况下,保护FFN路径,同时设置明确规范共享分配和有条件专业化的校准路由.
3) 实验表明,在可培训参数的可比预算下,与PEFT方法相比,在密集基线和MOE基线上,生产质量有所提高,下游适应能力也更强。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Large-scale pre-training enables vision models to learn transferable representations from labeled data [ 9 ] or self-supervision through instance discrimination [ 6 ] , masked prediction [ 2 , 19 ] , and self-distillation [ 36 ] .
In image generation, latent diffusion models [ 43 ] similarly learn generative priors that support subsequent adaptation for personalization [ 44 ] and spatial control [ 72 ] .
Such adaptation can be costly when the entire model is updated [ 53 , 1 ] .
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces this cost by restricting updates to prompts [ 25 ] , adapters [ 21 , 5 ] , low-rank factors [ 22 , 23 ] , or selected spectral components [ 17 , 42 , 52 , 73 , 71 ] .
Although these methods reduce the trainable parameter budget, they operate on conventionally pre-trained backbones without an explicit separation of transferable and source-specific knowledge, leaving limited downstream updates to accommodate target-specific requirements while mitigating source-domain bias.
blocks.zh:
大规模的预培训使视觉模型能够通过歧视[6]、蒙蔽的预测[2、19]和自我消化[36]从标签数据[9]或自我监督中学习可转移的表示。
在图像生成中,潜在扩散模型[43] 类似地学习了支持随后适应个性化的基因前传[44]和空间控制[72].
当整个模型更新[53, 1]时,这种适应可能代价高昂.
参数效率微调(PEFT)通过将更新限制在导出[25],适配器[21,5],低位因子[22,23],或选定的光谱组件[17,42,52,73,71],从而降低这一成本.
虽然这些方法减少了可培训参数的预算,但它们在常规的事先培训的骨干上运作,而没有明确区分可转让和源特定知识,留下有限的下游更新,以适应特定目标的要求,同时减轻源域偏差.

blocks.en:
Decomposable pre-training enhances the modularity of pre-trained models by learning reusable components.
The Learngene framework [ 12 , 13 ] encapsulates transferable knowledge in network fragments to support efficient downstream adaptation.
Within this framework, constraint-based pre-training [ 14 ] enables cross-scale knowledge reuse by imposing structural constraints during training through linear transformations [ 57 ] , Kronecker-product factorizations [ 15 ] , and other structured decompositions [ 59 , 63 , 47 , 48 ] .
Knowledge diversion (KDiv) [ 60 ] pursues cross-task knowledge reuse by separating condition-agnostic and condition-dependent knowledge into reusable components.
KIND [ 61 ] introduced this principle for class-conditional generation, while FAD [ 49 ] and DivMorph [ 11 ] extended it to frequency-aware adaptation and cross-morphology transfer, respectively.
Our SGKDiv advances knowledge diversion through native paired-channel construction and specificity-regularized optimization, jointly guiding knowledge organization and specialization.
blocks.zh:
可分解的预训通过学习可重复使用的组件,增强预训模型的模块性.
" Learninggene " 框架[12、13]将可转让知识封装在网络碎片中,以支持高效的下游适应。
在这一框架内,基于制约的预培训[14]通过线性转换[57]、Kronecker-产品成份化[15]和其他结构分解[59、63、47、48],在培训期间施加结构限制,从而能够实现跨规模的知识再利用。
知识转移(KDiv)[60]通过将条件不可知和条件依赖的知识分离为可重复使用的组件,追求跨任务知识再利用.
KIND[61]为阶级条件生成引入了这一原则,而FAD[49]和DivMorph[11]则分别将其扩展至频率感知适应和跨形态转移.
我们的SGKDiv通过本土配对通道建设和特异性规范化优化推进知识转移,共同指导知识组织和专业化.

blocks.en: SGKDiv learns reusable components through adaptive routing and specialization regularization. We first introduce Native Paired Knowledge Units (Sec. 3.2.1 ) to preserve FFN structure without SVD-based reparameterization, then learn their contributions through Calibrated Condition-Specific Routing (Sec. 3.2.2 ). Specificity-Regularized Optimization (Sec. 3.2.3 ) guides this allocation by regulating shared usage, conditional diversity, and specialization strength.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Native Paired Knowledge Units
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 土著知识单位

blocks.en:
Existing knowledge diversion methods [ 61 , 60 , 11 ] construct Knowledge Units through matrix-wise SVD, introducing redundant factor parameters without explicitly coupling consecutive projections.
SGKDiv instead defines Knowledge Units from paired native FFN channels, preserving this correspondence without factorization (see Fig. 2 a).

Native channel pairing avoids SVD-related overhead, reducing DiT-S total parameters from KIND’s 60.62 60.62 M to 34.59 34.59 M. Against KDiv, SGKDiv improves FID, IS, and Precision with comparable total parameters and fewer activated parameters, indicating benefits beyond compactness. These gains are consistent with adaptive routing and explicit regularization enabling more effective specialization than fixed shared–specific assignments alone.
blocks.zh: 与之前的知识分流方法相比,SGKDiv提供了更为紧凑和灵活的参数化. 原生通道对接避免了与SVD相关的间接费用,将DiT-S的总参数从KIND的60.62 60.62 M降低到34.59 34.59 M. 逆 KDiv, SGK. Div改进了FID、IS和精密度,其总参数可比较,激活参数较少,表明收益超出紧凑度。 这些收益与适应性路线和明确的正规化相一致,能够比固定的共享具体任务更有效地专业化。

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares SGKDiv with representative MoE baselines. On DiT-S, SGKDiv achieves the lowest FID and highest IS at both guidance scales.
At CFG 1.5 1.5 , it lowers FID from ProMoE-TC’s 38.147 38.147 to 33.070 33.070 , while reducing total parameters from 75.54 75.54 M to 34.59 34.59 M and activated parameters from 32.99 32.99 M to 31.79 31.79 M. These results demonstrate stronger generation performance with a substantially more compact model.
blocks.zh:
表2 比较 苏格兰 以具有代表性的教育部基线划分。 在DiT-S上,SGKDiv在两种指导尺度上都实现了最低FID和最高IS.
在CFG 1.5 1.5中,它将FID从ProMoE-TC的38.147 38.147降至33.070 33.070,同时将总参数从75.54 75.54 M降至34.59 34.59 M,激活参数从32.99 32.99 M降至31.79 31.79 M. 这些成果显示,一代人的业绩更强,模式更紧凑。

blocks.en:
Unlike token-wise expert allocation, SGKDiv modulates native paired channels according to conditions and explicitly regularizes their specialization.
This provides a consistent condition-level allocation across tokens, allowing differentiated computation without replicating full FFN experts.
The gains at comparable activated parameter counts and substantially lower total capacity suggest that effective specialization benefits from parameter organization and training beyond expert expansion, positioning SGKDiv as a compact alternative for improving generation quality.
blocks.zh:
与象征性的专家分配不同,SGKDiv根据条件对本土配对频道进行调制,并明确规范其专业化.
这提供了一种一致的条件级别分配,可以进行有区别的计算,而无需复制福尔多涅专家的全部。
可比的激活参数的收益计算在内,而且总能力大大降低,这表明,在专家扩展之外,参数组织和培训可带来有效的专业化效益,将SGKDiv定位为提高发电质量的紧凑选择。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Performance of SGKDiv in downstream adaptation. We compare SGKDiv with PEFT and knowledge diversion methods on datasets using FDD ↓ \downarrow , KDD ↓ \downarrow , and CMMD ↓ \downarrow . “GPU Time” and “Param.” denote adaptation time and trainable parameter count, respectively.

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance in Downstream Adaptation
blocks.zh: 5.2 下游适应的绩效

blocks.en:
Table 3 evaluates downstream adaptation on eight datasets beyond the pre-training distribution. SGKDiv achieves the lowest average FDD, KDD, and CMMD of 910 910 , 2.063 2.063 , and 1.121 1.121 , respectively, outperforming both PEFT and knowledge diversion baselines overall.
Gains across fine-grained categories, natural scenes, and remote-sensing imagery support effective component reuse under diverse domain shifts. Representative generated samples are shown in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh:
表3对培训前分布之外的8个数据集进行下游适应性评价。 苏格兰 Div的捍卫民主阵线、KDD和CMMD的平均成绩最低,分别为910 910、2.063 2.063和1.121 1.121,分别超过了PEFT和知识转移基线。
各种精细的类别、自然场景和遥感图像的收益支持在不同领域变化下有效再利用部件。 图3显示了代表性生成的样本。

blocks.en: Compared with PEFT methods, SGKDiv uses pre-trained routing to concentrate updates on target-relevant Knowledge Units. Under the same trainable parameter budget as PiSSA, it reduces average FDD from 1063 1063 to 910 910 and adaptation time from 1.14 1.14 to 0.90 0.90 GPU hours. These gains suggest that target-aware component selection improves the effectiveness of limited updates by aligning pre-trained knowledge organization with downstream requirements.
blocks.zh: 与PEFT方法相比,SGKDiv使用预先训练的路由,将更新集中在目标相关知识单位上. 在与PISSA相同的可训练参数预算下,它将捍卫民主阵线的平均时间从1063 1063小时减少到910 910小时,并将适应时间从1.14 1.14小时减少到0.90 0.90小时。 这些成果表明,目标意识部分的选择通过使经过事先培训的知识组织符合下游的要求,提高了有限更新的有效性。

blocks.en:
The gains over existing knowledge diversion methods suggest that effective transfer depends on how components are learned, beyond structural separation.
Fixed assignments constrain knowledge allocation around source conditions, which may not match downstream requirements. SGKDiv instead learns continuous contributions over native paired channels, with regularization promoting differentiated conditional adjustments without rigid component boundaries. Target-aware selection identifies useful units for joint adaptation while preserving unselected parameters, connecting pre-trained specialization to new-domain requirements and supporting stronger aggregate adaptation performance.
blocks.zh:
现有知识转移方法的收益表明,有效的转移取决于如何在结构分离之外学习部件。
固定任务限制围绕源头条件的知识分配,而源头条件可能不符合下游要求。 SGKDiv则通过本土对等渠道学习持续贡献,规范化促进有区别的有条件调整,不硬性组件界限. 目标意识选择确定联合适应的有用单位,同时保留未选定的参数,将预先培训的专业化与新领域要求联系起来,并支持加强总体适应绩效。

Figure 6 : Semantic structure of condition-specific knowledge allocation. (a) Loss increase under router-embedding replacements at different CLIP-based semantic ranks and random replacement. Semantically closer replacements incur smaller increases, indicating structured cross-condition reuse.

图6:特定条件知识分配的语义结构. (a) 不同基于CLIP语义等级的路由器-嵌入式替换和随机替换的损失增加。 从语义上来说,更换更接近,增加幅度较小,表明结构化的跨条件再利用。
(b) 国家 通过路由-协同性相似性,在K最近的班级中召回CLIP前10位邻居.

blocks.en: 5.3 Performance Under Model Compression
blocks.zh: 5.3 模型压缩下的性能

blocks.en:
We combine SGKDiv with OBS-Diff [ 74 ] to assess whether learned knowledge organization supports model pruning.
Fig. 4 shows that SGKDiv maintains nearly constant zero-shot FID up to 20 % 20\% pruning, whereas OBS-Diff deteriorates progressively. This stability indicates greater tolerance to moderate capacity reduction, consistent with learned allocation helping retained parameters preserve useful shared and conditional computation. The performance advantage also persists after 50K fine-tuning steps. Although aggressive pruning degrades both methods, SGKDiv consistently retains better generation quality, supporting the compatibility of its learned knowledge organization with model compression.
blocks.zh:
我们把SGKDiv和OBS-Diff [74] 结合起来,以评估学识丰富的知识组织是否支持模型的修剪.
图4显示,SGKDiv保持了近乎恒定的零射FID,高达20% 20 \% ,而OBS-Diff则逐渐恶化. 这种稳定性表明,对适度减少能力具有更大的耐力,这与帮助保留参数保存有用的共享和有条件计算的经验分配是一致的。 50K微调后,性能优势也持续存在. 虽然积极的普鲁恩可以降解两种方法,但SGKDiv始终保持更好的生成质量,支持其所学的知识组织与模型压缩的兼容性.

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 分析和分析

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation of routing and specialization regularization. We evaluate the learnable condition-agnostic gate, regularization losses, and polarization-guided annealing. “w/o Annealing” fixes α = 1 \alpha=1 , disabling annealing of the diversity and magnitude losses.
blocks.zh: 表4:路线和专业化规范化的调整. 我们评价可学习的条件不可知的大门、正规化损失和两极分化引导的反射。 “w/o Annaling”将α = 1\ alpha = 1 修正,使多样性和数量损失丧失殆尽。

blocks.en: 5.4.1 Ablation on Specificity-Regularized Optimization
blocks.zh: 5.4.1 特定-规范优化

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that removing any loss degrades generation performance. The largest deterioration occurs without ℒ div \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{div}} , which increases FID from 54.092 54.092 to 58.514 58.514 . These losses address complementary aspects of knowledge allocation, with ℒ pol \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{pol}} sharpening shared usage preferences and ℒ div \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{div}} and ℒ mag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mag}} regulating the diversity and strength of conditional adjustments. The results support explicitly guiding both shared allocation and conditional specialization.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,消除任何损失都会降低生成性能。 最大的恶化发生在没有L div \ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{ div}}}的情况下,FID从54.092 54.092增加到58.514 58.514. 这些损失解决了知识分配的互补方面,L Pol\ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{pol}强化共享使用偏好,L div\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{div}}和L mag\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{mag}}调节有条件调整的多样性和强度. 成果支持明确指导共享分配和有条件的专门化。

blocks.en: Disabling polarization-guided annealing increases FID to 56.696 56.696 despite retaining all losses, suggesting that fixed regularization can constrain later-stage optimization. Annealing relaxes the diversity and magnitude penalties as the shared prior polarizes, balancing early specialization guidance with subsequent generative refinement.
blocks.zh: 尽管保留了所有损失,但无法实现的两极分化导反射将FID增加至56,696,56,696,这表明固定的正规化可制约后期优化。 Annaling由于共享的前极化而放松了多样性和规模性惩罚,平衡了早期专业化指导与随后的基因改良.

blocks.en: 5.4.2 Ablation on Learnable Condition-Agnostic Priors
blocks.zh: 5.4.2 对可学习条件-不可知前科的考虑

blocks.en:
Table 4 shows that fixing the condition-agnostic prior (i.e., w/o Learnable G agn G_{\mathrm{agn}} ) increases FID from 54.092 54.092 to 58.492 58.492 , highlighting the value of learning shared allocation beyond controlling mean gate capacity. Independent of the input condition, this prior integrates training signals across conditions to establish a common reference for conditional specialization.
A fixed prior preserves aggregate capacity but cannot adapt shared allocation during pre-training, potentially forcing conditional adjustments to compensate for an unsuitable reference.
The results suggest that effective knowledge diversion requires both a learned condition-agnostic foundation and differentiated conditional contributions.
blocks.zh:
表4显示,确定条件不可知前(即w/olearnable Gagn G_{\mathrm{agn}})将FID从54.092 54.092提高到58.492 58.492,突出学习共享分配的价值超出控制平均门容量. 独立于输入条件,这之前会整合跨条件的训练信号,为有条件的专业化建立共同的参考.
固定的前期安排保留了总能力,但无法在培训前调整共享分配,有可能迫使有条件调整以补偿不适当的参考。
结果表明,有效的知识转移既需要学习到的条件不可知的基础,也需要有区别的有条件贡献。

blocks.en: 5.4.3 Analysis of Performance across CFG Scales
blocks.zh: 5.4.3 跨CFG规模的业绩分析

blocks.en:
We compare SGKDiv with the dense baseline across CFG scales. Fig. 5 shows that both attain their lowest FID near CFG 3.0 3.0 , with SGKDiv achieving a lower minimum FID and consistently higher IS. The Precision–Recall curves show higher precision at comparable low-to-moderate recall, with diminishing gains as coverage increases, suggesting improved fidelity rather than uniformly expanded coverage.
Since CFG amplifies differences between conditional and unconditional predictions, the learned shared prior and regularized conditional adjustments may support more effective guidance. Gains across CFG scales suggest that this benefit extends beyond a single sampling configuration.
blocks.zh:
我们把SGKDiv与整个CFG尺度的密集基线进行比较。 图5显示,两者均在CFG 3.0 3.0附近达到最低FID,而SGKDiv则达到最低FID和一贯较高的IS。 精确度-召回曲线显示,在可比的低度-中度召回时,精度较高,随着覆盖面的扩大,收益逐渐减少,这表明忠诚度有所提高,而不是统一扩大覆盖面。
由于CFG放大了有条件预测和无条件预测之间的差异,所学到的共享的事先和正规化的有条件调整可能支持更有效的指导. 跨CFG规模的增益表明,这一效益超出了单一抽样配置。

blocks.en: 5.4.4 Analysis of Semantic Knowledge Organization
blocks.zh: 5.4.4 语义知识组织的分析

blocks.en:
We assess the semantic organization of learned routing using CLIP text embeddings [ 41 ] as an external reference.
In Fig. 6 (a), replacing only the router embedding with that of a more distant class yields a larger loss increase.
This suggests that conditional contributions capture semantic distinctions while preserving computation reusable across related conditions.
Fig. 6 (b) shows that neighbors retrieved from the full routing coefficients recover CLIP top-10 neighbors above a random-retrieval baseline.
Together, these results suggest that specialization preserves cross-condition semantic relationships, supporting selective downstream reuse.
blocks.zh:
我们用CLIP文本嵌入[41]作为外部参考,评估所学路由的语义组织.
在图6(a)中,仅将嵌入的路由器替换为更远的类,损失就会增加。
这表明,有条件的缴款在保留计算可重复使用的各种相关条件的同时,能够体现语义上的区别。
图6(b)显示,从全路由系数中检索的邻居在随机检索基线之上恢复CLIP顶级-10邻居.
这些结果共同表明,专业化保留了跨条件语义关系,支持选择性的下游再利用.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv), which combines native FFN channel pairing, calibrated routing, and specialization regularization to learn reusable knowledge organization without SVD-based reparameterization or predefined shared–specific partitions. The resulting routing guides target-aware unit selection for downstream fine-tuning.
Experiments demonstrate improved in-distribution generation over dense and MoE baselines and stronger downstream adaptation than representative PEFT methods under comparable trainable parameter budgets.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了具体指导知识转换(SGKDiv),它结合了本土FFN频道对等,校准路由,专业化规范化,以学习可重复使用的知识组织,而无需基于SVD的再参数化或预先定义的共享-特定分区. 由此形成的路线指引 目标意识单元选择 下游微调.
实验表明,在可培训参数的可比预算中,比起有代表性的PEFT方法,在密集基线和教育部基线上,分配生成的改善和下游的适应性更强。
